title: WarehouseQueryInput
description: Invoke one of this extension's contributed warehouse_templates[] via the SDK's WarehouseReadHandle. `template` must be a name the extension declared (and whose underlying tables are inside this extension's capabilities.warehouse_read grant). `tenant_id` is bound from the caller by the host and cannot be overridden.

params.description: Template-specific parameters, validated host-side against the template's params_schema.
